traditions.WLC: אַחַ֣ר הַ דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ אֵ֗לֶּה
traditions.LXX: Μετὰ δὲ ταῦτα
traditions.VUL: Post hæc
traditions.KJV: After these things

1.english_reference: did king Ahasuerus promote Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite

traditions.WLC: גִּדַּל֩ הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֜וֹשׁ אֶת הָמָ֧ן בֶּֽן הַמְּדָ֛תָא הָ אֲגָגִ֖י
traditions.LXX: ἐδόξασεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἀρταξέρξης Ἁμὰν Ἁμαδάθου Βουγαῖον ,
traditions.VUL: rex Assuérus exaltávit Aman fílium Amadáthi , qui erat de stirpe Agag :
traditions.KJV: did king Ahasuerus promote Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite ,

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יְנַשְּׂאֵ֑ הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὕψωσεν αὐτὸν
traditions.KJV: and advanced him ,

1.english_reference: and set his seat above all the princes that [ were ] with him

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֨שֶׂם֙ אֶת כִּסְא֔ וֹ מֵ עַ֕ל כָּל הַ שָּׂרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπρωτοβάθρει πάντων τῶν φίλων αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et pósuit sólium eius super omnes príncipes , quos habébat .
traditions.KJV: and set his seat above all the princes that [ were ] with him .

2.english_reference: And all the king ’s servants , that [ were ] in the king ’s gate , bowed , and reverenced Haman

traditions.WLC: וְ כָל עַבְדֵ֨י הַ מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֲשֶׁר בְּ שַׁ֣עַר הַ מֶּ֗לֶךְ כֹּרְעִ֤ים וּ מִֽשְׁתַּחֲוִים֙ לְ הָמָ֔ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ προσεκύνουν αὐτῷ ,
traditions.VUL: Cunctíque servi regis , qui in fóribus palátii versabántur , flectébant génua , et adorábant Aman :
traditions.KJV: And all the king ’s servants , that [ were ] in the king ’s gate , bowed , and reverenced Haman :

2.english_reference: for the king had so commanded concerning him

traditions.WLC: כִּי כֵ֖ן צִוָּה ל֣ וֹ הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: οὕτως γὰρ προσέταξεν ὁ βασιλεὺς ποιῆσαι ·
traditions.VUL: sic enim præcéperat eis imperátor :
traditions.KJV: for the king had so commanded concerning him .

2.english_reference: But Mordecai bowed not , nor did [ him ] reverence

traditions.WLC: וּ מָ֨רְדֳּכַ֔י לֹ֥א יִכְרַ֖ע וְ לֹ֥א יִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶֽה
traditions.LXX: ὁ δὲ Μαρδοχαῖος οὐ προσεκύνει αὐτῷ .
traditions.VUL: solus Mardochǽus non flectébat genu , neque adorábat eum .
traditions.KJV: But Mordecai bowed not , nor did [ him ] reverence .

3.english_reference: Then the king ’s servants , which [ were ] in the king ’s gate , said unto Mordecai

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ עַבְדֵ֥י הַ מֶּ֛לֶךְ אֲשֶׁר בְּ שַׁ֥עַר הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ לְ מָרְדֳּכָ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐλάλησαν οἱ ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ τοῦ βασιλέως τῷ Μαρδοχαίῳ Μαρδοχαῖε ,
traditions.VUL: Cui dixérunt púeri regis , qui ad fores palátii præsidébant :
traditions.KJV: Then the king ’s servants , which [ were ] in the king ’s gate , said unto Mordecai ,

3.english_reference: Why transgressest thou the king ’s commandment ?

traditions.WLC: מַדּ֨וּעַ֙ אַתָּ֣ה עוֹבֵ֔ר אֵ֖ת מִצְוַ֥ת הַ מֶּֽלֶךְ
traditions.LXX: τί παρακούεις τὰ ὑπὸ τοῦ βασιλέως λεγόμενα ;
traditions.VUL: Cur præter céteros non obsérvas mandátum regis ?
traditions.KJV: Why transgressest thou the king ’s commandment ?

4.english_reference: Now it came to pass , when they spake daily unto him , and he hearkened not unto them

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֗י ב אמר ם אֵלָי ו֙ י֣וֹם וָ י֔וֹם וְ לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καθ᾽ ἑκάστην ἡμέραν ἐλάλουν αὐτῷ , καὶ οὐχ ὑπήκουεν αὐτῶν ·
traditions.VUL: Cumque hoc crébrius dícerent , et ille nollet audíre ,
traditions.KJV: Now it came to pass , when they spake daily unto him , and he hearkened not unto them ,

4.english_reference: that they told Haman , to see whether Mordecai ’s matters would stand

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּגִּ֣ידוּ לְ הָמָ֗ן לִ רְאוֹת֙ הֲ יַֽעַמְדוּ֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י מָרְדֳּכַ֔י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὑπέδειξαν τῷ Ἁμὰν Μαρδοχαῖον τοῖς τοῦ βασιλέως λόγοις ἀντιτασσόμενον ·
traditions.VUL: nuntiavérunt Aman , scire cupiéntes utrum perseveráret in senténtia :
traditions.KJV: that they told Haman , to see whether Mordecai ’s matters would stand :

4.english_reference: for he had told them that he [ was ] a Jew

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי הִגִּ֥יד לָ הֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁר ה֥וּא יְהוּדִֽי
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὑπέδειξεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Μαρδοχαῖος ὅτι Ἰουδαῖός ἐστιν .
traditions.VUL: díxerat enim eis se esse Iudǽum .
traditions.KJV: for he had told them that he [ was ] a Jew .

5.english_reference: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not , nor did him reverence

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֣רְא הָמָ֔ן כִּי אֵ֣ין מָרְדֳּכַ֔י כֹּרֵ֥עַ וּ מִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה ל֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπιγνοὺς Ἁμὰν ὅτι οὐ προσκυνεῖ αὐτῷ Μαρδοχαῖος ,
traditions.VUL: Quod cum audísset Aman , et experiménto probásset quod Mardochǽus non flécteret sibi genu , nec se adoráret ,
traditions.KJV: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not , nor did him reverence ,

5.english_reference: then was Haman full of wrath

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמָּלֵ֥א הָמָ֖ן חֵמָֽה
traditions.LXX: ἐθυμώθη σφόδρα ,
traditions.VUL: irátus est valde ,
traditions.KJV: then was Haman full of wrath .

6.english_reference: And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּ֣בֶז בְּ עֵינָ֗י ו לִ שְׁלֹ֤ח יָד֙ בְּ מָרְדֳּכַ֣י לְ בַדּ֔ וֹ
traditions.VUL: et pro níhilo duxit in unum Mardochǽum míttere manus suas :
traditions.KJV: And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone ;

6.english_reference: for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי הִגִּ֥ידוּ ל֖ וֹ אֶת עַ֣ם מָרְדֳּכָ֑י
traditions.VUL: audíerat enim quod esset gentis Iudǽæ :
traditions.KJV: for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai :

6.english_reference: wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that [ were ] throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus , [ even ] the people of Mordecai

traditions.WLC: וַ יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ הָמָ֗ן לְ הַשְׁמִ֧יד אֶת כָּל הַ יְּהוּדִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּ כָל מַלְכ֥וּת אֲחַשְׁוֵר֖וֹשׁ עַ֥ם מָרְדֳּכָֽי
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐβουλεύσατο ἀφανίσαι πάντας τοὺς ὑπὸ τὴν Ἀρταξέρξου βασιλείαν Ἰουδαίους .
traditions.VUL: magísque vóluit omnem Iudæórum , qui erant in regno Assuéri , pérdere natiónem .
traditions.KJV: wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that [ were ] throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus , [ even ] the people of Mordecai .

7.english_reference: In the first month , that [ is ] , the month Nisan , in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus

traditions.WLC: בַּ חֹ֤דֶשׁ הָ רִאשׁוֹן֙ הוּא חֹ֣דֶשׁ נִיסָ֔ן בִּ שְׁנַת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה לַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֑וֹשׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν ψήφισμα ἐν ἔτει δωδεκάτῳ τῆς βασιλείας Ἀρταξέρξου ,
traditions.VUL: Mense primo ( cuius vocábulum est Nisan ) , anno duodécimo regni Assuéri ,
traditions.KJV: In the first month , that [ is ] , the month Nisan , in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus ,

7.english_reference: they cast Pur , that [ is ] , the lot , before Haman

traditions.WLC: הִפִּ֣יל פּוּר֩ ה֨וּא הַ גּוֹרָ֜ל לִ פְנֵ֣י הָמָ֗ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔβαλεν κλήρους
traditions.VUL: missa est sors in urnam , quæ hebráice dícitur phur , coram Aman ,
traditions.KJV: they cast Pur , that [ is ] , the lot , before Haman

7.english_reference: from day to day , and from month to month , [ to ] the twelfth [ month ] , that [ is ] , the month Adar

traditions.WLC: מִ יּ֧וֹם לְ י֛וֹם וּ מֵ חֹ֛דֶשׁ לְ חֹ֥דֶשׁ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֖ר הוּא חֹ֥דֶשׁ אֲדָֽר
traditions.LXX: ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας καὶ μῆνα ἐκ μηνὸς ὥστε ἀπολέσαι ἐν μιᾷ ἡμέρᾳ τὸ γένος Μαρδοχαίου , καὶ ἔπεσεν ὁ κλῆρος εἰς τὴν τεσσαρεσκαιδεκάτην τοῦ μηνὸς ὅς ἐστιν Ἀδάρ .
traditions.VUL: quo die et quo mense gens Iudæórum debéret intérfici : et exívit mensis duodécimus , qui vocátur Adar .
traditions.KJV: from day to day , and from month to month , [ to ] the twelfth [ month ] , that [ is ] , the month Adar .

8.english_reference: And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֤אמֶר הָמָן֙ לַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα Ἀρταξέρξην λέγων
traditions.VUL: Dixítque Aman regi Assuéro :
traditions.KJV: And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus ,

8.english_reference: There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom

traditions.WLC: יֶשְׁנ֣ וֹ עַם אֶחָ֗ד מְפֻזָּ֤ר וּ מְפֹרָד֙ בֵּ֣ין הָֽ עַמִּ֔ים בְּ כֹ֖ל מְדִינ֣וֹת מַלְכוּתֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: Ὑπάρχει ἔθνος διεσπαρμένον ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ βασιλείᾳ σου ,
traditions.VUL: Est pópulus per omnes províncias regni tui dispérsus , et a se mútuo separátus ,
traditions.KJV: There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom ;

8.english_reference: and their laws [ are ] diverse from all people

traditions.WLC: וְ דָתֵי הֶ֞ם שֹׁנ֣וֹת מִ כָּל עָ֗ם
traditions.LXX: οἱ δὲ νόμοι αὐτῶν ἔξαλλοι παρὰ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ,
traditions.VUL: novis utens légibus et cæremóniis ,
traditions.KJV: and their laws [ are ] diverse from all people ;

8.english_reference: neither keep they the king ’s laws

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת דָּתֵ֤י הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֵינָ֣ ם עֹשִׂ֔ים
traditions.LXX: τῶν δὲ νόμων τοῦ βασιλέως παρακούουσιν ,
traditions.VUL: ínsuper et regis scita contémnens .
traditions.KJV: neither keep they the king ’s laws :

8.english_reference: therefore it [ is ] not for the king ’s profit to suffer them

traditions.WLC: וְ לַ מֶּ֥לֶךְ אֵין שֹׁוֶ֖ה לְ הַנִּיחָֽ ם
traditions.LXX: οὐ συμφέρει τῷ βασιλεῖ ἐᾶσαι αὐτούς .
traditions.VUL: Et óptime nosti quod non expédiat regno tuo , ut insoléscat per licéntiam .
traditions.KJV: therefore it [ is ] not for the king ’s profit to suffer them .

9.english_reference: If it please the king , let it be written that they may be destroyed

traditions.WLC: אִם עַל הַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ ט֔וֹב יִכָּתֵ֖ב לְ אַבְּדָ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: εἰ δοκεῖ τῷ βασιλεῖ , δογματισάτω ἀπολέσαι αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: Si tibi placet , decérne , ut péreat ,
traditions.KJV: If it please the king , let it be written that they may be destroyed :

9.english_reference: and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the hands of those that have the charge of the business , to bring [ it ] into the king ’s treasuries

traditions.WLC: וַ עֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֜ים כִּכַּר כֶּ֗סֶף אֶשְׁקוֹל֙ עַל יְדֵי֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י הַ מְּלָאכָ֔ה לְ הָבִ֖יא אֶל גִּנְזֵ֥י הַ מֶּֽלֶךְ
traditions.LXX: κἀγὼ ἐγὼ διαγράψω εἰς τὸ γαζοφυλάκιον τοῦ βασιλέως ἀργυρίου τάλαντα μύρια .
traditions.VUL: et decem míllia talentórum appéndam arcáriis gazæ tuæ .
traditions.KJV: and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the hands of those that have the charge of the business , to bring [ it ] into the king ’s treasuries .

10.english_reference: And the king took his ring from his hand

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֧סַר הַ מֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶת טַבַּעְתּ֖ וֹ מֵ עַ֣ל יָד֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ περιελόμενος ὁ βασιλεὺς τὸν δακτύλιον
traditions.VUL: Tulit ergo rex ánnulum , quo utebátur , de manu sua ,
traditions.KJV: And the king took his ring from his hand ,

10.english_reference: and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , the Jews ’ enemy

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּתְּנָ֗ הּ לְ הָמָ֧ן בֶּֽן הַמְּדָ֛תָא הָ אֲגָגִ֖י צֹרֵ֥ר הַ יְּהוּדִֽים
traditions.LXX: ἔδωκεν εἰς χεῖρα τῷ Ἁμάν , σφραγίσαι κατὰ τῶν γεγραμμένων κατὰ τῶν Ἰουδαίων .
traditions.VUL: et dedit eum Aman fílio Amadáthi de progénie Agag , hosti Iudæórum ,
traditions.KJV: and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , the Jews ’ enemy .

11.english_reference: And the king said unto Haman

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לְ הָמָ֔ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τῷ Ἁμάν
traditions.VUL: dixítque ad eum :
traditions.KJV: And the king said unto Haman ,

11.english_reference: The silver [ is ] given to thee

traditions.WLC: הַ כֶּ֖סֶף נָת֣וּן לָ֑ ךְ
traditions.LXX: Τὸ μὲν ἀργύριον ἔχε ,
traditions.VUL: Argéntum , quod tu pollicéris , tuum sit :
traditions.KJV: The silver [ is ] given to thee ,

11.english_reference: the people also , to do with them as it seemeth good to thee

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ עָ֕ם לַ עֲשׂ֥וֹת בּ֖ וֹ כַּ טּ֥וֹב בְּ עֵינֶֽי ךָ
traditions.LXX: τῷ δὲ ἔθνει χρῶ ὡς βούλει .
traditions.VUL: de pópulo age quod tibi placet .
traditions.KJV: the people also , to do with them as it seemeth good to thee .

12.english_reference: Then were the king ’s scribes called on the thirteenth day of the first month

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקָּרְאוּ֩ סֹפְרֵ֨י הַ מֶּ֜לֶךְ בַּ חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ רִאשׁ֗וֹן בִּ שְׁלוֹשָׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֣ר יוֹם֮ בּ וֹ֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκλὴθησαν οἱ γραμματεῖς τοῦ βασιλέως μηνὶ πρώτῳ τῇ τρισκαιδεκάτῃ ,
traditions.VUL: Vocatíque sunt scribæ regis mense primo Nisan , tertiadécima die eiúsdem mensis :
traditions.KJV: Then were the king ’s scribes called on the thirteenth day of the first month ,

12.english_reference: and there was written according to all that Haman had commanded

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּכָּתֵ֣ב כְּֽ כָל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֣ה הָמָ֡ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔγραψαν ὡς ἐπέταξεν Ἁμὰν
traditions.VUL: et scriptum est , ut iússerat Aman ,
traditions.KJV: and there was written according to all that Haman had commanded

12.english_reference: unto the king ’s lieutenants , and to the governors that [ were ] over every province

traditions.WLC: אֶ֣ל אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנֵֽי הַ֠ מֶּלֶךְ וְֽ אֶל הַ פַּח֞וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל מְדִינָ֣ה וּ מְדִינָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: τοῖς στρατηγοῖς καὶ τοῖς ἄρχουσιν κατὰ πᾶσαν χώραν ἀπὸ Ἰνδικῆς ἕως τῆς Αἰθιοπίας , ταῖς ἑκατὸν εἴκοσι ἑπτὰ χώραις ,
traditions.VUL: ad omnes sátrapas regis , et iúdices provinciárum ,
traditions.KJV: unto the king ’s lieutenants , and to the governors that [ were ] over every province ,

12.english_reference: and to the rulers of every people of every province according to the writing thereof , and [ to ] every people after their language

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶל שָׂ֤רֵי עַם֙ וָ עָ֔ם מְדִינָ֤ה וּ מְדִינָה֙ כִּ כְתָבָ֔ הּ וְ עַ֥ם וָ עָ֖ם כִּ לְשׁוֹנ֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: τοῖς τε ἄρχουσι τῶν ἐθνῶν κατὰ τὴν αὐτῶν λέξιν ,
traditions.VUL: diversarúmque géntium , ut quæque gens légere póterat , et audíre pro varietáte linguárum
traditions.KJV: and to the rulers of every people of every province according to the writing thereof , and [ to ] every people after their language ;

12.english_reference: in the name of king Ahasuerus was it written , and sealed with the king ’s ring

traditions.WLC: בְּ שֵׁ֨ם הַ מֶּ֤לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֹשׁ֙ נִכְתָּ֔ב וְ נֶחְתָּ֖ם בְּ טַבַּ֥עַת הַ מֶּֽלֶךְ
traditions.LXX: δι᾽ Ἀρταξέρξου τοῦ βασιλέως .
